ja: やあ　見ない顔だね

key: Since you've so kindly wandered into my house, any chance you'd be interested in this here Old Rod?
en: Since you've so kindly wandered into my house, any chance you'd be interested in this here Old Rod?
ja: せっかく　うちに来てくれたんだ。このボロのつりざお　いらないかい?

key: I'll tell you something: Azurine Lake used to be somethin' grand, with no end to the wonder it held.
en: I'll tell you something: Azurine Lake used to be somethin' grand, with no end to the wonder it held.
ja: 教えてやるよ。アズリン湖は　昔は立派なもんでな　不思議が尽きない場所だった

key: But now the only thing it holds is pollution.
en: But now the only thing it holds is pollution.
ja: だが　今あるのは　汚染だけだ

key: So I'm packin' up my things and leaving.
en: So I'm packin' up my things and leaving.
ja: だから　荷物をまとめて　出ていくのさ

key: This is my very last rod, but if it can be of any use to you, I'm happy to let you have it.
en: This is my very last rod, but if it can be of any use to you, I'm happy to let you have it.
ja: これが　最後の一本だが　役に立つなら　喜んでゆずるよ

key: No? Well, I suppose I can't fault you, since there's nowhere to fish.
en: No? Well, I suppose I can't fault you, since there's nowhere to fish.
ja: いらないか。まあ　釣る場所もないんだ　責められんな

key: I'll be headin' out soon. This place doesn't have nothin' for me anymore.
en: I'll be headin' out soon. This place doesn't have nothin' for me anymore.
ja: もうすぐ　ここを出るよ。この場所には　もう何もない
